```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Load libraries 
library(here)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(kableExtra)
```


```{r}
# Load data

huston_tifs <- list.files(path = "extreme-weather-impact-analysis/data/VNP46A1",
                        pattern = "\\.tif$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

feb7a <- read_stars(huston_tifs[1])
feb7b <- read_stars(huston_tifs[2])
feb16a <- read_stars(huston_tifs[3])
feb16b <- read_stars(huston_tifs[4])

roads_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"
highways <- st_read(here("extreme-weather-impact-analysis", "data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"), query = roads_query) 

buildings_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1 WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL) OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"

homes <- st_read(here("extreme-weather-impact-analysis", "data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"), query = buildings_query)

```


```{r}
# Merge rasters for both dates
feb7 <- st_mosaic(feb7a, feb7b)
feb16 <- st_mosaic(feb16a, feb16b)
```

# Blackout mask
```{r}
# Find the change in night lights 
difference <- feb7 - feb16

# Classifying a difference greater than 200 nW cm-2sr-1 as a blackout (presumably) caused by the storm
blackout_mask <- difference > 200

# Inspect the mask
plot(blackout_mask)

# Assign NAs to places that experienced drops less than 200 nW cm-2sr-1
blackout_mask[!blackout_mask] <- NA
plot(blackout_mask)

# Vectorize blackout mask
vectorized_blackout <- st_as_sf(blackout_mask) |> st_make_valid()
```


```{r}
# Coordinates for Huston area polygon
# (-96.5, 29), (-96.5, 30.5), (-94.5, 30.5), (-94.5, 29) 

# Create a bounding box from Hustoon area coordinates
bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, xmax = -94.5, ymin = 29, ymax = 30.5), crs = st_crs(4326))
# Huston area polygon
huston <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(bbox))

# Crop the blackout dataset to the Huston area
huston_blackout <- st_crop(vectorized_blackout, huston)
plot(huston_blackout)

# Reproject to NAD83 / Texas Centric Albers Equal Area
huston_blackout <- st_transform(huston_blackout, crs = st_crs(3083))
```


# Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask


```{r}
# Look at highways
tm_shape(highways) +
  tm_dots()
```

```{r}
# Reproject highways to match huston_blackout CRS
highways <- st_transform(highways, st_crs(huston_blackout))
```


```{r}
# Verify that CRSs match
if(st_crs(huston_blackout) == st_crs(highways)){
  print("coordinate reference systems match!")
}else{
  warning("coordinate reference systems do NOT match")
  print(paste("huston_blackout has ", st_crs(huston_blackout)$epsg, "EPSG"))
  print(paste("highways has",  st_crs(highways)$epsg, "EPSG"))
}
```


```{r}
# Identify areas within 200 m of all highways
highways_buffer <- st_buffer(highways, dist = units::set_units(200, "m"))
# Connect all identified areas
highways_200m <- st_union(highways_buffer)

tm_shape(highways_200m) +
  tm_polygons()
# Identify areas that are _futher_ than 200 m from highways
blackout_no_highways <- st_difference(huston_blackout, highways_200m)
plot(blackout_no_highways)

cat("There were", nrow(blackout_no_highways), "areas that experienced a blackout that were farther than 200 m from a highway")
```

# Identify the number of homes likely impacted by blackouts

```{r}
# Reproject homes to match huston_blackout CRS
homes <- st_transform(homes, st_crs(huston_blackout))
```

```{r}
# Verify that CRSs match 
if(st_crs(huston_blackout) == st_crs(homes)){
  print("coordinate reference systems match!")
}else{
  warning("coordinate reference systems do NOT match")
  print(paste("huston_blackout has ", st_crs(huston_blackout)$epsg, "EPSG"))
  print(paste("highways has",  st_crs(homes)$epsg, "EPSG"))
}
```


```{r}
# Crop homes to remove unnecessary data for faster processing
huston_homes <- st_crop(homes, huston_blackout)

# Select homes that overlaped with blackout areas (outside the 200 m buffer)
blackout_homes <- huston_homes |> 
  st_filter(y=blackout_no_highways, .predicate = st_intersects)
```

```{r}
cat("There were", nrow(blackout_homes), "homes that experienced a blackout that were farther than 200 m from a highway")
```
